findings.evidence: Lines 34 and 42 contain “subsequent parts of the roadmap development” and “Roadmap: ... Layer 3 ... target.” The rubric explicitly assigns roadmap attribution to the PR description and excludes roadmap targets and layer numbers from module docstrings, irrespective of existing repository examples.
findings.fix: Describe the currently provided mathematical scope without forecasting roadmap work, remove the roadmap reference from the module docstring, and retain roadmap attribution in the PR description’s `Roadmap:` line; keep the mathematical Johnson–Kotz–Balakrishnan reference.
findings.issue: The module docstring calls missing density, moment, and transform results “subsequent parts of the roadmap development,” and line 42 identifies a roadmap layer and target; both are project-process metadata rather than mathematical documentation.

summary: The module documentation still embeds roadmap planning metadata that will become stale as development and roadmap organization change.
